# Phase-closure fixtures

Fixtures for the rounds index and the exact-membership seal of
[ADR-EVI-0001](../../../law/adr/ADR-EVI-0001-canonical-closure-index.md). The rendered shape they
are checked against is specified in
[`docs/reference/cli/evidence-render.md`](../../../docs/reference/cli/evidence-render.md).

## Layout

Each adopter's closures live in their own directory, laid out as a repository root so a test can
point `--repo-root` (or `readClosures`) at a copy of it unchanged:

```text
tests/fixtures/closures/<adopter>/
  PROVENANCE.md                                   source repository, commit, and SHA-256 of every file
  record/proofs/compliance/closures/PC-NNNN.json  the adopter's phase closures, byte-exact
  record/derived/indexes/rounds.md                the adopter's own index, when it had one
```

`detran/` holds the DETRAN closures supplied for OE-01 of CMP-0004: twenty closures, PC-0018
superseding PC-0017 (R-0017) and PC-0020 superseding PC-0015 (R-0018), plus the index DETRAN
generated by hand. Its `PROVENANCE.md` records where they came from. Further adopter closures go
in a sibling directory with the same layout and their own `PROVENANCE.md`.

## Rules

- The files are byte-exact copies of adopter data. Do not edit, reformat, or regenerate them; a
  correction is a new copy from the adopter with an updated `PROVENANCE.md`.
- Tests never write here. A test that renders with `--out --write`, runs `--check`, or seals a
  round copies the directory to a temporary root first.
- The adopter's own `rounds.md` is evidence of what the adopter sealed, not the expected output.
  By the Owner ruling of 2026-10-01 the canonical rendering governs: a test compares the rendered
  rows (closure, round, supersedes, `merged_as`) with the adopter's rows and checks that every
  round the adopter sealed still seals, not byte identity with the adopter's file.

The tests that read these fixtures are
`packages/evidence/tests/closure-index.test.ts`,
`packages/cli/tests/unit/evidence-render-rounds.test.ts`, and
`packages/loop/tests/round-lifecycle-seal-membership.test.ts`.
